answer: By embedding zero-knowledge verifiable delay within indivisible staking collateral, the protocol builds a superlinear capital slashing matrix acting as a cryptographic vine binding agent identity to fixed costs. When adversaries launch a Sybil pulse, escalating slashing penalties guarantee marginal deviation costs outpace achievable rewards, collapsing spurious replication strategies. This cost spiral forces attacker expected utility into strictly negative bounds, ensuring a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium where rational agents elect cooperative participation.
